REWORK — replacement initialization: src/features/healthclues/ToolkitCollection.tsx initializes equipmentPosition to 1 and replaceEntryId to an empty string. Opening Request Equip/Replace only changes equipId; the occupant ID is populated only when the position select changes. Confirming the default occupied position therefore omits replaceEntryId, and a later dialog can retain stale replacement state. Server rejection versus mutation outcome is unknown.

UNVERIFIED — authoritative NPC equipment rules: App/BUSINESS_RULES.md and App/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md require NPC proximity, reviewed eligibility and account-scoped equipment validation. src/features/healthclues/ToolkitCollection.tsx sends equipment requests without station/proximity context. UNVERIFIED — existing tests: scripts/run-healthclues-game-e2e.mjs contains equipment lifecycle, Collection separation, history and isolation assertions, but uses synthetic Catalog rows, locally minted credentials and mocked Auth/OTP responses with local database/REST services. It expects retired onboarding and four equipped entries in one case. scripts/test-healthclues-world-db.mjs exercises synthetic SQL fixtures and legacy equip RPCs; neither supplied script establishes current NPC-origin or spotlight acceptance. No execution evidence was supplied.

In src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx, initialPlanPrompt opens Journey once guideReady is true and hides the guide without checking that welcome finished. src/features/healthclues/WellnessWorldGame.tsx enables that prompt for adaptive activation. Runtime ordering needs verification and reconciliation with the approved requirement.
